output.headline: Advent can add the target to its open platform in the sub-sector, with a provider record and a median price paid above the upper quartile.
output.differentiator: Its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on, and its 15.5x median multiple paid is above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x. Peer lines were not available for comparison. [A:angles, V:comps]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; pays above upper-quartile multiples

acquirer_overview.title: A global sponsor with a steady, mostly control-oriented deal record
points: Financial sponsor with 18 deals from 2016 to 2024; 15 closed (83%), and 17 of 18 were control deals (94%). [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Median deal of $124M, with 8 of 18 deals in the comparable $100M-$400M size band and 5 deals since 2022. [T:record, K:size_band, K:recent]
Flagship fund of about $25 billion (2022 vintage) and approximately $100 billion AUM as of November 2025. [P:1, P:2]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor in its likelihood; it has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [S:sector_rel, T:record]
Margin Improvement drove 7 of 18 deals, a motive that stands out against its 31% share across the file. That fits a target with a 16.8% margin. [M:margin_improvement, X:target]
The open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on rather than a new bet; size fit is a second sponsor angle. [A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Recent provider deals at sizes near the target's
points: Crest Care Partners (Healthcare Services, 2024): $304M recapitalization at 9.3x EV/EBITDA, closed, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2024-0120]
Crown Addiction Treatment (Behavioral Health, 2023): $123M recapitalization at 14.6x, closed. Principal Counseling (2021): $163M minority investment at 13.2x. [D:MA-2023-0108, D:MA-2021-0341]
Summit DSO (Dental, 2018): $303M merger of equals at 11.7x, closed, in the Midwest. [D:MA-2018-0184]

valuation_context.title: A 75th-percentile price is defensible, and Advent has paid at that level
points: 70 comparable deals show EV/EBITDA of 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th. [V:comps]
The 16.8% margin is above the comps' 12.9% median and above 87% of comps, which supports the 75th percentile. [V:comps, X:target]
Advent's median multiple paid is 15.5x. At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M, and the maximum price is $193M on a same-multiple exit or $216M on a 15.0x platform exit. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below its 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: A same-exit maximum of $193M sits below the $200M target, so the bid depends on underwriting the add-on exit. [V:lbo, X:target]

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of 18 deals was in the target's region, and regional fit is a slight factor against. [T:record, S:geo_fit]
risk_flags.mitigant: The one Midwest deal, Summit DSO, was $303M and closed. [D:MA-2018-0184]
risk_flags.reality: Regional experience is limited, but the platform and sub-sector fit carry the case. [S:geo_fit, A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Broad mandate beyond provider services
risk_flags.concern: 10 of 18 deals were outside provider services, and only 1 was in the target's own sub-sector. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: 7 deals were in adjacent provider sub-sectors, including the 2024 Crest Care Partners deal. [T:record, D:MA-2024-0120]
risk_flags.reality: Provider activity is real, at 8 of 18 deals, but not exclusive. [A:angles]

conviction.rationale: Rests on 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform giving an add-on route. The return at the asking price is the main caveat. [C:conviction, A:angles, V:lbo]
